review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 consistently specify exact-key, live-map listener counts, including duplicate registrations, symbols, wildcard isolation, external map/array mutations, and unchanged emission snapshot behavior. The exact writable binding scope includes the implementation/type declaration source and both required regression files without requiring gratuitous edits. Repository configuration and the supplied microbundle source evidence support treating index.d.ts and dist as generated artifacts, not separately maintained owners, and requiring a rebuild before root-import runtime and type checks. TASK-IMPLEMENT and the dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY match the specification. The supplied project team facts support the selected implementer and verifier through active trusted claims for the relevant API, TypeScript, shared-data/state, and testing capabilities; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending legacy claims are not needed to justify those assignments, and the synchronous local API does not itself require asynchronous or integration-boundary capabilities. A separate configured reviewer supports the state/data review prerequisite. No unresolved material Decision is supplied for this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; this does not waive the decisions-stage block that an unresolved material DEC-001 would require in another input. The Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and whitespace-only PRD persistence normalization. Original preparation placeholders do not contradict the subsequently frozen preview. Review is based solely on the supplied specification and evidence, before any candidate on this bundle; I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, or create or independently attest human capability confirmations. No material error or ambiguity was identified.
